name: context-menu
title: Context menu
description: Menu opened on an object (right-click, long-press, Menu key): Menu's rows and submenus; marks the object while open.
whenToUse: Use it for commands on an object opened by right-click, long-press or Shift+F10. For a menu opened from a visible trigger use Menu.

parts.name: ContextMenuPopup
parts.description: The menu: Base UI's Portal, Positioner and Popup in one part, with the positioner's placement props lifted (Base UI places it at the pointer). Not docked to an owner: control weight on every side and a minimum width of its own. The surface is Menu's (MenuSurface), so it carries `data-slot="menu-popup"`.

parts.name: ContextMenuTrigger
parts.description: The area the menu opens on. Rendered as another part (`render={<Item />}`), the element is that part's and carries its data-slot; the mark while open is added to it.
